subdivision_of_building: Ground and Basement, and rear elevation
description: Alterations to the roof, removal of existing equipment and installation of new plant and associated works
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>The extraction equipment/ducting hereby approved, or the operation of any building services plant, shall not commence until a post-installation noise assessment has been carried out to confirm compliance with the noise criteria. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and attenuation measures, and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order for the duration of the use and its operation.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area.</p>

<p>Details of a Cleaning and Maintenance Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the relevant works commence. Details shall include odour control, extraction system maintained and cleaned every 3 months, all ducting maintained and cleaned every six months unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority, and maintained in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.</p><p>REASON: In order to safeguard the amenities of neighboring occupiers in terms of the smells/odours from cooking.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of development, full details of the extractor duct and associated plant and odour control system shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To ensure the extractor system is professionally and appropriately engineered, incorporating sound and odour control measures to minimize the impact on residents.</p>
